## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation plus Financials/Healthcare leadership (MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND); leadership concentration is Narrow (4/5 top performers from Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%).  
Technology strong on 1W momentum but mixed on 1M: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%).  
Financials consistent: MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%).  
Energy soft: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%).  
Real Estate lagging: DLR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), ADBE RECOVERY (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%), APD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: T BELOW TREND (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%), CAT CORRECTION (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%), LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) — weakness concentrated across pockets of Tech, Industrials and Telecom.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence: several megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) show 1W up vs 1M down (RECOVERY), flagging tactical risk despite RISK-ON.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: strong 1W breadth but negative 1M for many names, indicating short-term rotation and narrow leadership; PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: leaders are ABOVE TREND and sustaining 1M gains, supporting risk-on tone; MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive-strength within the risk-on market: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure and reduce exposure to narrow Technology leaders until 1M confirmation; monitor megacap RECOVERY names for follow-through and treat current strength as tactical opportunities rather than broad-based accumulation. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a Risk‑On backdrop given Financials/Healthcare confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%).  
BEARISH: LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth positive; leaders ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Utilities and Energy (both showing sector weakness this week).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for reclaiming its 1M trend to exit BELOW TREND status; AAPL sustainment of 1W gains to confirm RECOVERY; MA maintaining 1M gains to extend ABOVE TREND momentum; LRCX failure to hold recent bounce would reinforce downside CORRECTION risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (+80): What JPMorgan's larger dividend/buyback means — price action mixed: JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) so news aligns with 1M strength but 1W needs follow-through. (Other bullish headlines in feed: PM +80, LMT +55, SCHW +60 – monitor those tickers for price confirmation.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-50): Vltava Fund calls overvaluation — LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) — bearish sentiment aligns with sharp 1W weakness (distribution).  
META (-45): Zuckerberg comments on AI reorg — META RECOVERY (1W: +7.37% | 1M: -2.37%) — negative headlines but 1W strength = divergence to watch.  
BA (-45): IT outage headline — BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +4.04%) — bearish news diverging from price (monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style.  
MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major divergence across megacaps (many in RECOVERY) and narrow tech leadership — monitor news-confirmation (LRCX, META, BA) before adding to thematic Tech exposure.
